component.name: Lumen
component.summary: Chat with Ollama models and MCP tools

description.p: Lumen is a native GNOME chat application for Ollama. Connect to a local or remote Ollama server, stream responses, and keep conversations on your computer.
Attach images, text files and PDFs, render Markdown and equations, and connect tools through the Model Context Protocol. Built-in tools provide isolated Python calculations and optional Brave Search.
Ollama and models are installed separately. Brave Search requires your own API key.
Conversation search updates after replies and version changes. Scrolling up pauses automatic following while replies stream, and returning to the bottom resumes it.
Updated Lumen branding, Brave Search setup guidance, documentation and screenshots.
Scalable vector icons throughout Lumen, including a theme-aware monochrome mark and a full-color desktop icon.
